product_sources: The CMake project compiles or includes the actual patched tdesktop sources from TDESKTOP_SOURCE_DIR. Product implementations are not copied into this test directory.
crypto: Official public CFRG P-521/SHA512/AES256GCM HPKE Auth test vectors including RFC DeriveKeyPair rejection sampling, point/scalar validation, application envelope and padding boundaries, wrong identities/contexts, selected-record mutation failures, account-bound encrypted backups.
files: Actual file-payload packing and image-metadata sanitation helper: legacy document compatibility, authenticated document/image presentation, strict pixel-only PNG chunk/CRC/decode checks, orientation, 12MP image resizing and overflow rejection; also tests the actual pure media image-size helper. Native download scheduling, photo delegates, cache clearing and preview/save callbacks require application validation.
store_facade: Actual sealed-key-store implementation plus the real directory registry compiled against a deliberately fake application/storage facade. The registry adapter derives explicit test roots and account directories. The facade uses test-only reversible bytes plus a digest to exercise persistence failures and parser validation. It does not implement or validate Telegram local encryption or full application lifecycle. The duress boundary is a fake gate/writer facade here; its durability and native trigger are not proved by this facade. Successful private writes also exercise a test-only notification counter; failed and idempotent writes must not publish a key change. Native observers and UI invalidation are not exercised.
interop: Independent Python cryptography implementation decrypts outputs generated by the C++ crypto test with publicly known RFC fixture identities. Requires Python package cryptography.
limitations: No full Tele build or application UI is performed by these tests.
No Telegram login, live send/receive, native local key encryption, logout/session lifecycle, or on-device passcode protection is proved by the facade.
Tests must not be used with real user identities or production secrets.
No native KDF-failure injection or real lock-screen duress/ordinary-passcode precedence is validated by the pure gate test.
dependencies: Qt6 Core and Gui development files with JPEG and PNG plugins
Optional Python3 plus cryptography for independent interoperability
rng_failure: Separate OpenSSL process with unavailable DRBG; verifies random calls fail and encryption operations refuse to continue. Does not prove entropy quality on a healthy or compromised operating system.
duress_store: Actual fixed-cost verifier and bounded profile manifest/tombstone implementation using temporary directories only. Covers used A versus unused B/new C, retained known-wiped denies, unsafe-path failures, activation persistence and per-slot recovery. Native lock-screen derivation, real first-identity UI/storage creation, slot-owner migration, cancellation, live account operations and forensic erasure are not validated.
codes_filter: Actual deterministic decoy display string helper. Native history, notifications, clipboard, search, translation, expiry and persisted-policy integration require separate application tests.
signout_plan: Actual pure signout planner from the product header, tested with simulated acknowledgments and fresh-session snapshots. Covers exact identity selection, bounds, current-session changes, retries and remote-before-local ordering. Does not send native requests, revoke sessions or validate live server behavior.
code_mode_facade: Actual code-mode product source and pure filter with synthetic application/session/history/timer/UI objects and temporary files. Checks policy bounds/context, masking, translations, URL removal, duplicate activation, unchanged active duration, expiry restoration, cache cleanup and a write failure. Does not validate real native UI, HistoryItem hooks, clipboard/search/accessibility/export coverage, lifecycle or the passcode-protected repair dialog.
registry: Actual bounded monotonic profile directory registry and shared exact-three-filename cleanup in temporary directories. Checks registration-before-private-writer, writer/cleanup exclusion, failed/partial writes, permanent registration, corrupt/busy state, exact cleanup and unrelated-file preservation, default no-registry behavior, nonexistent/non-directory roots and stable linked/junction paths. It does not prove native ordinary-proof ordering, logout/passcode lifecycle, protection after a power loss or resistance to a concurrent filesystem attacker.
passcode_gate: Actual pure product passcode-gate header. Checks the ordinary-verdict/duress-match matrix, suppression with absent or failed native-key evidence, sticky failure in either observation order, unchanged inactive-hook results and nested scope restoration. It does not inject failure into native Argon2/scrypt, run the worker-to-main verification chain, or exercise warm/cold lock screens; those integration checks remain pending.
auto_mode: Actual pure product automatic-mode parser and key-fingerprint binding helper. Covers bounded versioned settings, malformed nonempty settings failing closed, account/network/peer isolation, changed or missing pins, and identity-only reading of own-sent copies. It does not validate native key-cache lifecycle, deferred callbacks, dialogs, compose routing or Telegram transport.
send_plan: Actual pure send-authorization proof helper. Tests account/network/chat/key/epoch binding, inclusive lifetime and overflow-safe clock bounds, text/reply and encrypted file-content digest matching, uploaded-file identifiers, strict filename normalization after exact ciphertext proof, immutable ID binding and text/file type separation. Native RPC TL parsing, exact call-site composition, one-shot consumption, compose routing and real lifecycle require application validation.
view_cache: Actual pure view plaintext cache and publication-stamp helper. Tests independent byte ownership, count/byte bounds, LRU eviction, explicit erasure/clear, and cipher/context/key/epoch publication matching. Native visibility, clearing of populated text strings, selection/copy/accessibility and account lifecycle are not validated.
rich_text: Actual pure rich-text serializer and multipart codec linked to the real HPKE engine. Tests native composite/custom-emoji ID preservation, canonical UTF8/UTF16 span/dictionary bounds,1024-byte legacy compatibility,64-part maximum, sender/recipient/Saved copies, private hash/size framing, all-part authentication, wrong key/context, mutations, duplicate/incomplete/mixed groups, whole hash and isolated entropy failure. Native tag semantics, send queue, loaded-neighborhood grouping, rendered formatting and account lifecycle remain application checks.
rich_send_plan: Actual STL-only product once-only multipart cursor and capacity helpers used by the native sender. Tests all counts1..64, every tail index, duplicate first acceptance, reentrant dispatch, cancellation before/after acceptance/mid-tail, invalid/extreme indices and exact16-group/1024-part/4MiB budgets with overflow-safe failures. It does not validate native queue ordering, server acknowledgments, Telegram RPCs or account lifecycle.
jobs_plan: Actual product six-slot CPU admission budget used by the scheduler: three normal-only and three shared Normal/Search slots, default Normal reserved-first placement, Search restricted to shared slots, total cap, pool-specific release, repeated saturation/drain and unknown-purpose rejection. Native async execution, main-thread enforcement, RAII token lifetime and coalesced wakeups require integration validation.
search_plan: Actual pure encrypted-search policy/resource/matching helpers used by runtime: default-off and selected private-peer blocking, account/network separation, unknown and malformed policy, zero IDs, channel exclusion,2000-candidate/8MiB bounds, integer extremes, Russian case-folded/NFKC substring matching and empty-query rejection. Native MTProto parsing, provider-script suppression, recent-query persistence, UI dispatch, paging and worker lifecycle remain integration checks.
